description: This header defines macros for transforming variadic macro arguments into repeated macro invocations, including concatenation and argument expansion macros, used internally in the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_CAT
methods.description: Concatenates two tokens after macro expansion.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_TRANSFORM_ARGS
methods.description: Applies a macro to each argument in a variadic list, up to 32 arguments, generating a comma-separated list of macro invocations.
